question: Should this replacement branch’s typed login-method API and global WhatsApp browser identity become the permanent contract, superseding https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866?
rationale: Both branches solve the same feature, while the public Plugin SDK shape and global linked-device identity are long-lived compatibility choices that source review and unit tests cannot decide.

options.title: Adopt with scoped identity
options.body: Use this typed API, retain the existing default socket identity, and apply the Chrome tuple only where phone-code pairing requires it before running live proof.

options.title: Adopt as written
options.body: Accept the new tuple for every WhatsApp socket after exact-head physical-device evidence proves QR and phone-code upgrade behavior.

options.title: Retain the earlier PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866 as canonical if its API and already supplied live proof better match maintainer intent.

recommendation.title: Adopt with scoped identity
recommendation.body: Use this typed API, retain the existing default socket identity, and apply the Chrome tuple only where phone-code pairing requires it before running live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr is assigned to this replacement and owns its complete API and state-machine design, making them the best available coordinator for the final decision.
